purpose: One file row in a FileUpload: format icon, name, status, size readout, progress bar and the actions for its stage of the upload. It shows where a single file is in its lifecycle.

notFor.case: Any use outside a FileUpload list.
A generic progress bar with no file attached.
A file attached as a removable tag in a compact field.

Status=queued.visual: Surface/layer-1 row with a Border/default edge; icon, status icon and label Content/secondary; name Content/primary, meta Content/secondary.

Status=uploading.visual: As queued, plus the progress track Surface/muted with the bar Action/primary/default.

Status=paused.meaning: Stopped by the person; can resume.
Status=paused.visual: As uploading: Border/default edge, Content/secondary readouts, the bar Action/primary/default at its last value.

Status=completed.visual: Status icon and label Status/success/content; edge Border/default.

Status=error.meaning: Upload failed; shows the reason and Retry.
Status=error.visual: Edge Status/critical/border; icon, status icon and label Status/critical/content.

a11y.role: progressbar on the bar (aria-valuenow); every action is an IconButton with its aria-label (Pause, Resume, Remove, Retry, Change, Download)
a11y.keyboard: Each action is a button in the tab order (Tab, Enter / Space).
notes: Completed, removed and failed files are announced from the FileUpload's live region, not by the row.

openQuestions: Paused and uploading draw the bar with the same role (Action/primary/default) and the same readout colours. Should paused look different beyond its status text?
